spec_match.rationale: Added a "CSS path-length property" mode: pathLength attributes are removed and a single `.svg-row.mode-css .draw-path { path-length: 100 }` rule is the only normaliser; the table reports the observed normaliser (attribute vs computed path-length vs none).

interactive.rationale: Animate-all, reset, a duration slider with readout, measured px-length labels and a live measurement table are real interactions (assessed from code review and the rendered DOM; the controls were not driven in this session).

blurb_alignment.rationale: Note and code sample now contrast the classic attribute with the v149 CSS property.

edge_cases.rationale: CSS.supports('path-length','100') banner (role=status); when unsupported, CSS mode shows the honest partial draw and the table says "CSS rule dropped" — no faked fallback. Verified false in Chromium 153 even with --enable-experimental-web-platform-features, so no flag is advertised.

references.rationale: Fixed 2026-10-04 (weekly hardening): the page now links https://chromestatus.com/feature/4861677550043136, matching its feature index — restoring invariant 3 and the fix-slugs self-heal. Verified by grep against the canonical id on the feature index.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite probes the real CSS property contract and honestly fails 4 of 6 in this browser; notably none of this page's behaviour depends on those assertions, confirming the page is off-surface.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12 via Playwright (NOT chrome-devtools-mcp, unavailable in this cloud session) against a local server, desktop 1280x800 and mobile 360x740 DPR3 touch: attribute mode Animate all (dashoffset 100->0), switch to CSS mode (attributes removed, table shows dropped rule, partial draw visible), Reset, back to attribute mode, emulated reduced motion (jumps to drawn state); zero console errors.

design_system.rationale: Variables throughout; .btn and .btn.primary set background and color together.

accessibility.rationale: Each SVG named for its shape, mode toggles use aria-pressed in a labelled group, duration slider named, progress text is role=status and announces completion.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Cards wrap, table scrolls in its own wrapper; 0px document overflow at 360x740 and 1280x800.

summary: Weekly hardening 2026-11-15: added a CSS path-length property mode with exact-surface support probe and observed-normaliser table, ghost resting strokes, per-shape SVG names, reduced-motion end state and progress announcements. Verified in headless Chromium 153 desktop+mobile with zero console errors.

guidanceConsulted.query: external reference links list rel noopener semantics
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep target=_blank external links on rel=noopener; no further guidance matched a plain reference-list addition.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: the restored ChromeStatus links use target=_blank rel=noopener in the page's existing see-also list pattern; change is a reference-list fix only, no layout/control/CSS behavior touched.

guidanceConsulted.query: SVG stroke draw animation path length prefers-reduced-motion
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Respect prefers-reduced-motion and keep the final state when the animation is skipped.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: under reduce, Animate all jumps to the fully drawn end state and announces completion.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Native buttons with programmatic state; announce dynamic state changes non-visually; do not add aria-pressed to a button whose label changes to describe its state.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: aria-pressed on fixed-label toggles, polite role=status summaries.

guidanceConsulted.query: horizontal scroller for wide fixed width content on narrow viewport
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Content must fit its space without page-level horizontal overflow.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: wide fixed-width content scrolls inside its own overflow-x:auto wrapper.

guidanceConsulted.query: SVG stroke draw animation path length prefers-reduced-motion
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Expose meaningful graphics with an accessible name and hide decorative copies from AT.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: shape-specific aria-labels; ghost paths aria-hidden.
